pages.title: Courses Platform
pages.description:
Your own online school: sell memberships, post weekly video lessons and run live Q&A from one website and app.

· For teachers, coaches and instructors who teach a following on Instagram or TikTok
· Visitors browse courses, watch a free sample class, pick a plan and pay online
· Members sign in to this week's lessons, videos, downloadable lists and plans, and live class links
· Progress follows members from website to iPhone to Android
· Full English and Spanish, with a switch at the top
· Joining works inside Instagram's and TikTok's browsers, with no account needed first
· Smaller packages show a waitlist form instead of checkout
pages.outcome:
· Live demo: Cocina Viva, a made-up bilingual cooking school
· Every feature works in the demo, with sample content and "Try as a member / Try as the owner" logins
· Payments, video storage and emails get connected for each client
· Can be reworded for fitness, tutoring or music with one switch
· Coming soon: live chat on the site
bestFor: Creators with an Instagram or TikTok following

pages.title: Photographer Platform
pages.description:
Bilingual site for photography studios — clients browse the gallery, compare packages, and book a session with a deposit.

· Owner side: client list, job pipeline (inquiry → delivered), invoices, and messages
· Gallery by session type: weddings, quinceañeras, portraits, events, real estate, commercial
· Packages and pricing with the retainer that holds each date
· Step-by-step booking that takes a deposit
· Client portal: session status (booked → shoot → editing → delivered), balance due, and contract
· English and Spanish pages at their own URLs, so both rank in search
· Web, iOS, and Android from one codebase
pages.outcome:
· Ready: gallery, packages, deposit booking, and client portal
· Card deposits (Stripe) wired per client
bestFor: Photographers who want booked sessions with a deposit, not DMs

pages.title: Trade Services Platform
pages.description:
White-label website and back office for trade businesses (cleaning, roofing, pressure wash, etc.)—customers book online; the team runs jobs in one place.

· Customers: services, quotes, booking, online pay, messaging, order lookup by email
· Owners: one dashboard for leads, schedule, jobs, billing, customer history
· Crew: today’s jobs and status updates without full admin access
· Recurring visits, payment links, gallery + reviews, post-job photo/review page
pages.outcome:
· Production-ready trade-services platform (forked from a live field-service build)
· Quote → schedule → get paid without spreadsheets and text threads
· Web for customers and office; optional mobile for crews
bestFor: Tap to pay on site — no card reader

pages.title: Restaurant Ordering Platform
pages.description:
Branded ordering site for restaurants, cafés, and food trucks — customers browse the menu, order for pickup, and track it live; the kitchen runs every order from one board.

· Menu with categories, photos, add-ons, sold-out items, and search
· Cart with tip selector and desktop split checkout
· Live order tracking: received → preparing → ready → completed
· About, hours with an open/closed banner, and find-my-order pages
· Event and announcement banners you change yourself
· Light and dark theme on desktop, tablet, and phone
pages.outcome:
· Ready: menu, pickup ordering, live tracking, and kitchen board on one live database
· Card payments (Stripe) wired per client
bestFor: Any business selling from a daily menu
